svg.title: Estia architecture: one Mac mini at home, reached only through Signal
svg.desc: Diagram of how Estia is wired. In the middle, the mac mini @ home. Inside it: Messages and calls (the bridge, signal-cli, an optional call helper); Thinking (Ollama's official build running Gemma 4, with cloud models refused, and the optional AgentJev, which marks bulk mail before Gemma); Voice, optional (the voice service for speech to text and back, Whisper, Kokoro); Languages and calls, optional (Supertonic-3 for the other ten languages, a speech detector, a turn detector); Helpers (an optional read-only calendar helper, an optional device helper for the home network, a YouTube helper for captions); Memory and files (a SQLite database with chats, memory and mail headers, an optional documents helper that reads your PDFs and needs no network, optional read-only project tools). She runs in her own hidden macOS account; the bridge listens on nothing; there is no web app and no open port; code goes live only through an update. On the left, your phone and your laptop reach the Mac only through Signal's servers, end-to-end encrypted in both directions, for texts, voice notes, photos, PDFs, locations and calls. The laptop is a linked device: its texts are held, unread, until the phone approves it. The call helper reaches Signal's relay servers itself. On the right, read-only: Microsoft 365 mail and Outlook calendar, Google Calendar, and iCloud, Fastmail, Nextcloud and other CalDAV calendars, which are read and never changed (CalDAV is not tested live); and questions out: Ollama web search, Brave Search as the backup search, web pages (links you send and Brave's top result), YouTube captions and Google Maps. At the top, downloads into the Mac: the model from the Ollama library and voice models from Hugging Face, once; code and tools from GitHub, Homebrew and crates.io. At the bottom, the home network only: Philips Hue, TP-Link Kasa and Tapo, Bose SoundTouch; and music commands out to Spotify. Limits: only the Signal accounts in the config get an answer, other senders are ignored, never rejected; no cloud AI service, no account with us, no telemetry; no web app and no open port; no shell for the AI; mail is never sent, moved, deleted or marked; calendar events are never created, changed or answered; mail, project and document text never go to a search engine or Google Maps; mail bodies, YouTube captions, web results and map results are never stored, photos are deleted after the first answer; callers never learn the Mac's internet address.
svg.text: Architecture: one Mac mini at home,
No web app, no open port
Code goes live only through an update
Texts, voice notes, photos, PDFs, locations and calls
Search words, a link, a place or a music command
Never through the TP-Link or Philips cloud
Off until it is set up
A box has the colour of its line.
A dashed green border marks read-only.

answer. Other senders are ignored, never rejected.
no account with us, no telemetry.

it cannot type commands on the Mac.
